data.body: The first close attempt stopped at the unchecked acceptance-criteria precheck before invoking the completion verifier. During remediation, an unsafe shell quoting form interpreted Markdown backticks and temporarily expanded the description to 442,964 characters. No repository files changed. The description was restored through a literal single-quoted argument and then read back from the ticket store. The restored description is 3,793 characters, contains the Context, Plan, Verification, and Acceptance Criteria headings, has 10 checked acceptance items, and has no unchecked acceptance items. The acceptance wording is unchanged.
